title: Zeroth homology of the categorical open Čech complex
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $U_j$ an open cover indexed in $u$, and $F$ an $\\mathrm{Ab}_{u+1}$-valued sheaf on its open-set site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $F(X)$ is additively isomorphic to the degree-zero homology of the categorical Čech complex of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex]. No finite-cover, affineness, separatedness, or acyclicity hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 21.8.2, degree-zero Čech cohomology equals sections for a sheaf; used in 03AZ

proof.text: Restrict a section to every one-fold categorical product. The two face restrictions coincide, so the augmentation is a degree-zero cycle. One-fold products still cover X: for each j the diagonal U_j to its one-fold product gives the needed inclusion.

Project d(c)=0 to the two-fold product associated to any two one-tuples. It says the two restrictions agree. Restrict further to the intersection of their one-fold products. Unique sheaf gluing makes the augmentation bijective onto the cycles. This uses Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' and eq_of_locally_eq', and the proved upstream formula TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctor_d_π.
The complex has no incoming differential at degree zero, so homologyπ in degree zero is an isomorphism. Compose this with the augmentation-to-cycles isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_openCech_zerothHomology
    {X : TopCat.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Opens X) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)

    Nonempty (F.obj.obj (op ⊤) ≅ ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.obj).homology 0)
